consequence.statement: This is a new optional capability for the Kyverno CLI; existing policy testing workflows and cluster operations are not affected.

assertion.statement: Kyverno CLI now supports dynamically injecting global context entries using a Values file, allowing simulation of different scenarios during policy testing without modifying cluster resources.
